task: Create ONE single playing card as a finished front-facing card image (not a photo of a card, no table, no hands).

style.medium: hand-drawn cartoon illustration by a professional comic and children's-book illustrator, confident black ink linework with fine hatching, soft watercolor and colored-pencil shading
style.character_design: humorous, slightly exaggerated caricature, big expressive eyes, cheeky grin or funny expression, warm and charming, never childish or crude
style.palette: warm natural earth tones, muted pastels, gentle highlights, no neon colors
style.background: mostly clean off-white / cream card background; only a small, light themed vignette around or under the subject (a patch of ground or a few props), no full-color background fill
style.card_frame: trading-card layout, portrait 2:3, rounded corners, thin white outer border, inner area with soft paper texture
style.number_style: hand-lettered bold chunky numerals, warm golden-yellow fill with thick dark-brown outline and slight drop shadow, like a classic 1990s German family card game
style.composition: subject large and centered, slightly overlapping the vignette, top-left corner kept free for the number
style.consistency: all cards of this set share exactly the same line weight, shading technique, frame, number font and paper texture

card.subject: two bulging money sacks leaning against each other, stamped with a coin symbol, coins spilling

number.note: the ONLY text on the card

card.frame_accent: money card of the same set: thin gold inner frame line, otherwise identical frame to the animal cards

negative_prompt: photorealism, 3D render, glossy CGI, flat vector, anime, pixel art, text other than the specified number, animal names, words, letters, logos, watermark, signature, full saturated background color, busy scenery, cropped subject
